title: Prompt-Based Bias Calibration for Better Zero/Few-Shot Learning of Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on calibrating intrinsic statistical biases (such as token frequency and label word association) to improve the classification performance of language models. It explicitly distinguishes its work from studies on social fairness or ethics, noting that its primary objective is performance efficiency in downstream tasks. It contains no evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
